en.title: The Witcher 3 Remastered Release Times Confirmed: When Geralt Arrives Near You
en.summary: CD Projekt Red has detailed the global launch schedule for The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt – Remastered. Savvy players can plan their perfect time to dive back into Geralt's world on September 29th.
en.body:
The wait is almost over for **The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt – Remastered**, and CD Projekt Red has finally laid out the global release times. Mark your calendars for September 29th, when Geralt of Rivia's iconic adventure gets a significant visual and performance overhaul across PC, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and Nintendo Switch 2. For those who already own **The Witcher 3**, this comprehensive upgrade is a welcome freebie, bringing enhanced visuals, gameplay improvements, and more to your existing copy. The remaster also marks a new platform for the game, with PC players gaining access via Battle.net for the first time, alongside the usual GOG, Steam, and Epic Games Store offerings.

This isn't just a simple texture pack; **The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt – Remastered** boasts a suite of enhancements designed to bring the beloved RPG into the current generation. Players can expect a visual feast with upgraded graphics, alongside crucial gameplay tweaks. These include enhanced combat mechanics, improved traversal and movement systems, revamped mount handling for smoother rides across the Continent, and more dynamic monster behaviors. The skill tree has been revisited, transmogrification options will allow for more character customization, and an expanded photo mode will let players capture the breathtaking world in stunning detail. New Witcher sign effects and finishers add extra flair to Geralt's already formidable arsenal. This substantial update is a testament to the game's lasting legacy, ensuring new and returning players alike can experience one of the greatest RPGs ever made with a fresh coat of paint.

## Global Launch Breakdown

CD Projekt Red has synchronized the release to 12 PM CEST in Poland, meaning release times will vary significantly across the globe. Western regions will get the remaster earlier in the day, while Eastern locales will see it arrive later on September 29th. For instance, Los Angeles players can jump in at 3 AM PDT, New York at 6 AM EDT, and London at 11 AM BST. Further east, Beijing will see the release at 6 PM CST, and Tokyo and Seoul at 7 PM JST and KST respectively. Melbourne can expect it at 8 PM AEST, with Auckland rounding out the major regions at 11 PM NZDT. This staggered release ensures that fans worldwide can begin their journey as soon as possible on the confirmed platforms.

## What This Means for the Continent

Fans have been eagerly anticipating this remaster, especially after the initial tease at Gamescom. The inclusion of the critically acclaimed expansions, **Hearts of Stone** and **Blood and Wine**, as part of the package (and free for existing owners) is a massive draw. This release solidifies **The Witcher 3**'s position as a genre-defining title, offering a complete and visually stunning experience. The anticipation is palpable, with many players already planning their return to the Continent or preparing to embark on Geralt's epic saga for the very first time. The free upgrade model is a particularly player-friendly move, rewarding the dedicated community that has supported the game for years.

## What's Next

Beyond the remaster's launch, the future of **The Witcher 3** also includes the upcoming expansion, **Songs of the Past**, slated for a 2027 release. This new content will introduce the entirely new realm of Letten, promising a fresh narrative and new challenges for players to overcome. For now, however, all eyes are on September 29th and the grand return of **The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt – Remastered**.

content_raw: CD Projekt has confirmed the global release times for The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt – Remastered . As detailed in a social media post , The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt – Remastered comes out on September 29 at 12pm in Poland, where CD Projekt is based. All other release times across the globe are tied to this CET release. So, if you’re wondering if it’s worth keeping the day free (book off from work, perhaps?), the farther west you are, the earlier the game goes live. The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt – Remastered launches across PC, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X and S, and Nintendo Switch 2, but it’s also a free upgrade for those who own the base game. The remaster will also be sold on PC via Battle.net for the first time. There's pre-purchase for Switch 2 and Battle.net (those are the only new versions of the game, as The Witcher 3 didn't exist before on those two platforms). GOG, Steam, Epic, Xbox and PlayStation are getting the remaster as an update, so there's no preload on those platforms. Expect a slew of upgrades and enhancements to visuals, performance, gameplay, and more. There’s enhanced combat, improved traversal and movement, new witcher signs effects, revamped mount handling, enhanced monster behaviors, a skill tree revamp, transmogrification, expanded photo mode, and new finishers. The launch precedes the arrival of Songs of the Past, The Witcher 3's third expansion, due in 2027. The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt – Remastered global release times: Los Angeles: 3am PDT Mexico City: 4am CST Bogota: 5am COT New York: 6am EDT Brasilia: 7am BRT Accra: 10am GMT London: 11am BST Warsaw: 12pm CEST Cape Town: 12pm SAST Kyiv: 1pm EEST Beijing: 6pm CST Seoul: 7pm KST Tokyo: 7pm JST Melbourne: 8pm AEST Auckland: 11pm NZDT This week, The Witcher 3 fans reacted to an official comparison clip featuring a snippet of side-by-side gameplay from the original game and the remaster, with some saying the new version actually looks worse. In the clip, you can see Geralt casting Igni on a group of drowners in the swamp. While the new version of the game has much greater detail on Geralt's armor, along with much more defined water, the reflections seem to be divisive.
